Mixed-use hotel developments—combining a hotel with residences, retail, offices, entertainment, convention space, or serviced apartments—typically consider brands with strong global distribution, flexible design standards, and experience managing shared facilities.

## Commonly considered brands

| Positioning | Brand families frequently shortlisted |
|---|---|
| **Ultra-luxury and branded residences** | **Four Seasons**, **Ritz-Carlton**, **St. Regis**, **Mandarin Oriental**, **Rosewood**, **Aman**, **One&Only**, **Raffles**, **Waldorf Astoria**, **Park Hyatt**, **Six Senses**, **Regent**, **The Luxury Collection**, **EDITION** |
| **Luxury and upper-upscale** | **JW Marriott**, **Conrad**, **LXR**, **Fairmont**, **Sofitel**, **InterContinental**, **Grand Hyatt**, **Andaz**, **Thompson Hotels**, **W Hotels**, **Shangri-La**, **Langham**, **Kempinski**, **Anantara**, **Jumeirah** |
| **Upper-upscale, full-service urban** | **Marriott Hotels**, **Sheraton**, **Westin**, **Renaissance**, **Le Méridien**, **Hilton Hotels & Resorts**, **Curio Collection**, **DoubleTree**, **Canopy**, **Hyatt Regency**, **Hyatt Centric**, **Crowne Plaza**, **Kimpton**, **Hotel Indigo**, **voco**, **Pullman**, **Swissôtel**, **Mövenpick**, **MGallery** |
| **Lifestyle and collection brands** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **The Luxury Collection**, **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, **LXR**, **Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**, **The Standard**, **Vignette Collection**, **MGallery**, **Mondrian**, **Mama Shelter**, **SLS**, **25hours** |
| **Select-service and compact urban** | **Courtyard**, **AC Hotels**, **Moxy**, **Aloft**, **Four Points**, **Hilton Garden Inn**, **Hampton**, **Tru**, **Hyatt Place**, **Caption by Hyatt**, **Holiday Inn**, **Holiday Inn Express**, **Novotel**, **Mercure**, **ibis Styles** |
| **Extended-stay and serviced apartments** | **Residence Inn**, **Element**, **TownePlace Suites**, **Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy**, **Homewood Suites**, **Home2 Suites**, **Embassy Suites**, **Hyatt House**, **Staybridge Suites**, **Candlewood Suites**, **Adagio**, **Novotel Living**, **Mondrian Living** |

Marriott explicitly positions itself as experienced in mixed-use residential and dual-brand projects. Accor provides a dedicated mixed-use and residential platform, Accor One Living, while Hilton, Hyatt, and IHG extend numerous brands into residential developments. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/hotel-development?utm_source=openai))

## Brands especially associated with hotel-plus-residence projects

For developments where condominium or villa sales are important to project financing, the most frequently considered flags tend to be:

- **Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W, EDITION and JW Marriott**
- **Four Seasons**
- **Mandarin Oriental**
- **Rosewood**
- **Raffles, Fairmont, Sofitel, SLS and related Accor brands**
- **Waldorf Astoria, Conrad and LXR**
- **Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson and The Standard**
- **Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental and Kimpton**
- **Aman, One&Only, Banyan Tree, Anantara and Shangri-La**

Four Seasons is particularly residential-oriented: a substantial majority of its hotel-development pipeline has included a residential component. Rosewood likewise reports that approximately half of its portfolio and pipeline includes residences. ([press.fourseasons.com](https://press.fourseasons.com/news-releases/2024/private-residences-growth/?utm_source=openai))

## Typical shortlist by development type

- **Major urban tower with luxury residences:** Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood, Waldorf Astoria, Raffles, Park Hyatt.
- **Office-retail-transit mixed-use district:** Marriott, Hilton, Hyatt Regency, Grand Hyatt, InterContinental, Pullman, Westin, Sheraton.
- **Lifestyle neighborhood development:** W, EDITION, Andaz, Thompson, Kimpton, Hotel Indigo, Canopy, Moxy, The Standard, SLS, Mondrian.
- **Dual-brand hotel complex:** Courtyard/Residence Inn, AC/Element, Hampton/Home2 Suites, Hilton Garden Inn/Homewood Suites, Hyatt Place/Hyatt House, Holiday Inn/Staybridge Suites. Hilton identifies combinations such as Tru–Home2 Suites and Hilton Garden Inn–Homewood Suites among its common dual-brand pairings. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/double-the-brand-the-rise-of-dual-brand-hotels?utm_source=openai))
- **Resort with villas or residences:** Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Rosewood, One&Only, Six Senses, Raffles, Fairmont, Mandarin Oriental, Aman, Anantara, Banyan Tree.

The final shortlist should be based not just on brand prestige but on **market depth, residential-price premium, key-money availability, management versus franchise structure, territorial restrictions, room count, shared-facility requirements, loyalty-program contribution, and achievable hotel rate positioning**.
